 Emotional Farewell: Joe Cruz Says Goodbye in Chicago Fire's 300th Episode on Nov. 4
 0 Share Paulette Cohn 2026년 10월 21일 수 오후 9:15 UTC The 300 th episode of Chicago Fire is just around the corner, airing on Nov. 4, and it will be an emotional one because it will be the farewell to first responder Joe Cruz ( Joe Miñoso ), who has been a part of Firehouse 51 since the beginning back in 2012.
 In the milestone 300th episode of the series, Cruz will continue to make strides in rehabbing the spinal injury that caused him to be paralyzed, which happened in the Season 14 finale, but it’s clear – at least for now – that there’s no way he can return to active duty, so he shows up at 51 to say his goodbyes.
 🎬 SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 
 “I think it’s important to honor the real risks that these folks take every day for all of us,” showrunner Victor Teran told Parade of his decision to injure Cruz, leading to the original cast member being written out of the series. “I think that’s why we went so hard into the severity of the injury, short of death. This is going to be not as bad as it gets, but it’s pretty darn bad. And this is just the kind of thing that happens. We need to tell stories like this because it’s real. And if we don’t ever do it, I think we can lose credibility.”
 Also in the 300 th episode, simply titled, “Three Hundred,” Firehouse 51 responds to a complex hostage situation, and Chief Tomlin ( Doug Savant ) gives Severide ( Taylor Kinney ) an impossible task.

 Taylor Kinney, Joe MiñosoCredit: Peter Gordon/NBC Taylor Kinney as Kelly SeverideCredit: Peter Gordon/NBC The news that Miñoso would be exiting the series was first revealed back in July.
 Chicago Fire airs Wednesday nights at 9 p.m. ET/PT on NBC. Streams next day on Peacock.
